distinguishing_negative_control.real_backing: the REAL provider holds the city CITY_STATE report in its REAL roster; the first eligible lookup is a staged question that names the placement the host ACTUALLY served (the entry the scan last served), reached the city stage (fixed facts read, fixed, a city, first building served, not under a city) and was answered over the held state without a refusal (city_state_joined counts it: positive consumption)
distinguishing_negative_control.host_only_removal: before that real answer is handed on UNCHANGED, the host sends the SAME provider the withdrawal word of the fixed report for that key (answered removed): only the city own state of that record goes; the placement, its list, its object identity, the campaign Core entity, the question and the reply are untouched
distinguishing_negative_control.actual_next_question: the NEXT question that names the withdrawn placement AT the city stage (a building of the city names its own key, and the stage-0 question reads nothing of the state) is delegated unchanged and the real provider refuses it by its named cause [candidate.city] the host withdrew the collision state of this city; the run stops at [model-provider:entity_candidate.refused]; request faults 0, reply faults exactly 1, first fault "candidate reply: result refused"; the withdrawal is counted apart (city_state_withdrawn 1, city_state_withdrawn_next "city", cause city_state_withdrawn)
distinguishing_negative_control.what_it_distinguishes: removing the list or the whole record would prove the wrong dependence and is not done; a withdrawn FIXED state, a withdrawn building or a withdrawn sector entry are other causes and other markers; a wrong but live key neither credits nor mutates (request fault, test pinned)
distinguishing_negative_control.honest_UNREACHED: UNREACHED when no question of a city whose state the host held reached the position-and-box stage (a case with no city with a building), or when the withdrawn city was never asked about at that stage again; a request or reply fault, or an engine stop at another marker, BEFORE the withdrawal is reported as that failure and is never UNREACHED; a question at the stage that was answered after the withdrawal is a hard failure (the provider ignored it). No actor, time or geometry is hunted and no pseudo-war is configured
distinguishing_negative_control.counters: city_state_before/after/total/stated/joined/withdrawn/withdrawn_next/held_lifetime/withdrawn_cause; held state is populated in BOTH windows (city_held is set before the launch); a healthy armed-report count can legitimately be zero and is not required to establish previously reported canonical data
distinguishing_negative_control.eligibility_for_the_native_case: whether the default ordinary case reaches a SECOND question of the same served city at the city stage is a fact of the native run, not asserted here: the mode is eligible only on Root natives (a hosted build with the model provider and the driver); a clean run with none is UNREACHED by construction
